specification.title: Cambridge OCR Level 3 Advanced GCE in Computer Science H446 Specification

notes: Board provisional: OCR H446 is the likely board until the owner confirms it. Structure and references (1.1.1(a) to 2.3.1(f)) follow section 2c of the specification (Components 01 and 02); the programming project (Component 03 or 04) is non-exam assessment and is not in this tree. One leaf per lettered point; 1.5.2 has no lettered points, so it is one leaf. Topic titles are short summaries written for RevisionDen, not specification text.
